title: OP-Bench: Benchmarking Over-Personalization for Memory-Augmented Personalized Conversational Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a synthetic benchmark (OP-Bench) using LLM judges and embedding-based similarity to measure Irrelevance (inappropriately injecting user profile attributes into off-topic queries) and Repetition (repeatedly reusing the same user memories across distinct queries).

Testing whether models over-align with user beliefs or preferences by using synthetic queries that invite agreement with factual inaccuracies, fabricated memories, or extreme value claims. The responses are evaluated using an LLM-based scorer to assign a sycophancy resistance score.
